name: Iran nuclear programme
summary: Iran rejected IAEA Board resolutions on 14 Nov and bars normal inspections; no strike on nuclear sites found
state: Iran's mission in Vienna said on 14 Nov that IAEA Board of Governors resolutions on Iran were legally flawed and that normal safeguards inspections will not resume under current conditions (Tasnim). The Board referred Iran to the UN Security Council for non-compliance in September (Arms Control Association). No NPT withdrawal or new strike on a nuclear site was found by 21 Nov, so Watch holds on curtailed inspector access.
for_you: No direct effect for most people. The dispute feeds into the wider Gulf conflict and oil markets.

why: A nuclear-armed Iran — or strikes to prevent one — could ignite the Gulf and send oil far higher.

rubric.alert: Strikes on nuclear sites, NPT withdrawal, or evidence of weaponisation.
rubric.watch: Enrichment at ≥ 60% or inspector access curtailed, or credible strike threats.
rubric.normal: IAEA access and active diplomacy; no escalation.
